sprint-book.description: Preserve the canonical five-day Sprint intent, sequence, exercises, timeboxes, and five-customer target wherever the one-human-plus-AI team model permits.
sprint-book.teamModelLimitation: A single human Decider working with AI specialists is an explicit adaptation of the Sprint book's cross-functional human team model, so this profile is never described as fully book-faithful.

adaptive-design-sprint.description: Choose methods and duration for the challenge while preserving the non-negotiable learning loop and documenting every material adaptation.
adaptive-design-sprint.teamModelLimitation: AI specialists expand the range of analysis but do not provide independent human stakeholder knowledge or customer evidence.

live.limitation: Customer findings remain directional and must state sample, protocol, and prototype limitations.

self-test.limitation: This run rehearses the process. Synthetic activity cannot be presented as customer evidence or validation.

planning-rehearsal.limitation: This workspace is a plan or rehearsal, not evidence that the described sprint activities occurred.

nonNegotiablePrinciples.statement: A human Decider owns consequential choices.
The prototype is designed to answer agreed questions.
Only suitable real customers provide customer evidence.
Observed evidence is separated from inference.

01-intake.canonicalPurpose: Frame the consequential challenge, intended outcome, constraints, evidence, and unknowns before committing to a sprint.
01-intake.bookDefaultMethod: Pre-sprint challenge intake and Decider alignment

02-qualify.canonicalPurpose: Choose a route that matches the uncertainty instead of applying sprint ceremony by default.

03-evidence.canonicalPurpose: Create shared understanding from relevant knowledge and evidence before solution generation.
03-evidence.bookDefaultMethod: Expert interviews, shared knowledge, and How Might We notes
03-evidence.adaptiveDefaultMethod: Sourced evidence review and early recruitment planning

bookSubstitutions.canonicalMethod: Expert interviews and shared team knowledge
bookSubstitutions.selectedMethod: Bounded human or external-expert inputs plus a sourced evidence review
bookSubstitutions.preservedPurpose: Make relevant knowledge visible to every later role before solutions are generated.
bookSubstitutions.reason: The one-human-plus-AI team does not contain the cross-functional human knowledge assumed by the canonical exercise.

impact.methodFidelity: Replaces a live cross-functional knowledge-sharing exercise with traceable asynchronous inputs.
impact.evidence: Quality depends on the supplied sources and access to suitable external experts; AI synthesis adds no firsthand evidence.
impact.decisionReadiness: Unrepresented operational or domain knowledge may remain unknown and should narrow later decisions.

04-foundation.canonicalPurpose: Establish a coherent customer, problem, advantage, alternative, and differentiation hypothesis when one does not yet exist.
04-foundation.bookDefaultMethod: Not a separate Sprint-book exercise; use an established challenge and strategic context

05-map.canonicalPurpose: Build shared understanding of the customer journey or system and select the most consequential target moment.
05-map.bookDefaultMethod: Map the challenge from actors to outcome and select a target

06-questions.canonicalPurpose: Turn the long-term goal and riskiest assumptions into agreed questions and observable failure signals.
06-questions.bookDefaultMethod: Long-term goal, sprint questions, target selection, and Decider confirmation

07-explore.canonicalPurpose: Diverge independently into multiple concrete, evidence-aware solution directions before evaluating them.
07-explore.bookDefaultMethod: Lightning Demos followed by four-step sketching
07-explore.adaptiveDefaultMethod: Independent concrete solution directions with a sourced precedent scan

bookSubstitutions.preservedPurpose: Gather useful patterns and inspiration without converging on the first familiar answer.
bookSubstitutions.reason: The AI-assisted team cannot recreate a room of teammates presenting firsthand examples.

impact.methodFidelity: Changes a synchronous show-and-tell into a bounded research activity.
impact.evidence: Precedents are secondary evidence and must retain sources, dates, and relevance limits.
impact.decisionReadiness: The Decider should treat precedent fit as an inference, not proof that a direction will work.

bookSubstitutions.canonicalMethod: Four-step sketching by multiple human team members
bookSubstitutions.selectedMethod: Independently generated concrete solution flows or sketches from bounded specialist roles
bookSubstitutions.preservedPurpose: Create genuinely different, inspectable solutions before any recommendation is shared.
bookSubstitutions.reason: Only one human is participating, so bounded AI roles supply independent exploration without acting as customers or decision-makers.

impact.methodFidelity: Preserves independent concrete divergence but changes the source and diversity of contributors.
impact.evidence: AI-generated directions are proposals, not evidence of stakeholder or customer preference.
impact.decisionReadiness: Missing human disciplines or lived experience may leave options and risks underrepresented.

08-decide.canonicalPurpose: Converge deliberately on one coherent direction while keeping decision criteria, dissent, and rejected alternatives visible.
08-decide.bookDefaultMethod: Art museum, heat-map review, speed critique, straw poll, and Decider supervote
08-decide.adaptiveDefaultMethod: Independent role assessments followed by the human Decider

bookSubstitutions.canonicalMethod: Team heat-map voting and straw poll before the Decider supervote
bookSubstitutions.selectedMethod: Independent role assessments followed by the human Decider
bookSubstitutions.preservedPurpose: Expose perspectives and trade-offs without transferring the consequential choice away from the Decider.
bookSubstitutions.reason: AI role assessments cannot be counted as human team votes.

impact.methodFidelity: Retains Decider ownership but substitutes structured assessments for human team voting.
impact.evidence: Assessment convergence reflects analysis, not stakeholder support or customer preference.
impact.decisionReadiness: The Decider must account for missing stakeholder perspectives and preserve dissent.

09-experiment.canonicalPurpose: Translate the chosen direction into a fixed hypothesis, realistic storyboard, and observable test signals.
09-experiment.bookDefaultMethod: Storyboard the customer test from opening scene through critical moments

10-prototype.canonicalPurpose: Build and trial-run the smallest realistic prototype capable of answering the agreed questions.
10-prototype.bookDefaultMethod: Divide-and-conquer realistic prototype build plus trial run
10-prototype.adaptiveDefaultMethod: Bounded prototype build with independent critique and research-readiness review

11-customer-sessions.canonicalPurpose: Observe suitable real customers encountering the prototype under a consistent protocol.
11-customer-sessions.bookDefaultMethod: Five one-to-one customer interviews observed by the sprint team
11-customer-sessions.adaptiveDefaultMethod: Planned one-to-one sessions with suitable real customers

bookSubstitutions.canonicalMethod: Sprint-team watch party during five one-to-one interviews
bookSubstitutions.selectedMethod: Five one-to-one interviews plus deliberate observation and debrief checkpoints using traceable session summaries
bookSubstitutions.preservedPurpose: Keep individual observations visible across sessions so patterns can be identified without repairing inconvenient evidence.
bookSubstitutions.reason: A one-human-plus-AI run has no cross-functional human team available to observe together.

impact.methodFidelity: Keeps the five-customer interview target but adapts the team observation mechanic.
impact.evidence: Traceable session records preserve observations, but the run loses multiple simultaneous human observers.
impact.decisionReadiness: A single human perspective can miss signals; limitations and contradictory sessions must remain visible.

12-synthesis.canonicalPurpose: Compare observed customer evidence against the predefined questions and expose patterns, contradictions, outliers, and limitations.
12-synthesis.bookDefaultMethod: End-of-customer-day pattern review against sprint questions
12-synthesis.adaptiveDefaultMethod: Traceable question-by-question synthesis with independent critique

13-outcome.canonicalPurpose: Make a bounded human-owned decision that states what was learned, what remains unknown, and the next learning action.
13-outcome.bookDefaultMethod: Decider review and post-sprint next-step decision
13-outcome.adaptiveDefaultMethod: Evidence-limited outcome decision and owned handoff
